title: phlomis herba-venti subsp. kopetdaghensis
intro: Phlomis herba-venti subsp. kopetdaghensis, commonly known as the Kopetdag Flaxleaf Phlomis, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The Kopetdag Flaxleaf Phlomis has been traditionally used to treat gastrointestinal issues and has shown potential in reducing inflammation. Its health benefits are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
